name: chordleaf
description: A local-first workspace for lyrics, guitar chords and printable rehearsal sheets.

scripts.test:e2e: node tests/browser.mjs && node tests/mobile-browser.mjs && node tests/ios-text-browser.mjs && node tests/chords-browser.mjs && node tests/missing-chords-browser.mjs && node tests/workspace-browser.mjs && node tests/import-browser.mjs && node tests/instrumental-browser.mjs && node tests/new-song-browser.mjs && node tests/readiness-browser.mjs && node tests/long-song-browser.mjs && node tests/accessibility-browser.mjs && node tests/project-browser.mjs && node tests/diagram-export-browser.mjs && node tests/document-settings-browser.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts build server api vercel.json vite.config.js docs *.md index.html package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts build server api vercel.json vite.config.js docs *.md index.html package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .github
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm test && SITE_URL=https://chordleaf.com pnpm build && pnpm check:metadata
